description: In-agent marketplace surface: deep-dive style browse/compare with grants and savings context, opened in GreenwaysAgentContentModule. Advisors stay in chat; shopping completes browse → shortlist → buy handoff without inventing a parallel catalogue or cart.

Shortlist + Ask Artemis/Vincent/Andrieus + Buy on Greenways Market
Dual compare lane (marketplace vs sust_*) with Suggest for Greenways intake
Shared marketplace hero backdrop + frosted glass (Agent Market + home/about/hvac modules)

primaryAgents.role: Primary shop guide — equipment compare & renovation context

principles: One catalogue truth — etl_* / products-with-grants* / sustainable catalog; no forked product JSON for Agent Market
Deep-dive architecture for browse & compare — not a second full Wix shop UI inside every agent
Same content-module shell as story chips and agent tablets — chat stays behind
Agents advise; Market completes the closed loop (browse → decide → shortlist → buy handoff)
Purchase stays on real marketplace / Wix until phase 4 — Agent Market does not invent checkout
Grants, projection, and finance tablets stay one click from any product card
Fail open: works without member login; personalise later via shortlist + profile

No stats strip; no card collage in hero

userStories.title: Agent Market HTML shell + route
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want an Agent Market page I can open in the same in-panel module as other portal tools.
acceptanceCriteria: HTML at HTMLS GWM GWB/greenways-agent-market.html
Route GET /greenways/agent-market (and static under HTMLS GWM GWB)
Wix no-scroll meta; overflow-x hidden; works desktop and mobile
Hero + lane strip placeholders; no fake products
Registered in data/greenways-content-modules.json as id agent-market

userStories.title: Open from story + agent sidebars
userStories.description: As a visitor on the agents story or an agent chat, I want one click to preview Agent Market in the module shell.
acceptanceCriteria: greenways-agents-story.html tool chip or fifth chip opens data-module-open=agent-market
Artemis and Zyanne quick links include Agent Market (moduleOpen)
Module cover returnLabel works (Back to story / Back to Artemis)
Does not change existing marketplace-home module behaviour

userStories.title: Curated product rails with grants chips
userStories.description: As a buyer, I want to browse a short curated set of marketplace products with grant context, not a blank shop.
acceptanceCriteria: data/agent-market-showcase.json lists etl_* ids by lane (min 3 lanes, ≥3 products each)
Cards load grant counts/names from products-with-grants* by id (same overlay as deep dive)
Open detail uses root-relative /product-page-v2-marketplace.html?product=…&fromPopup=true
Broken/missing product ids skip gracefully (no empty broken cards)

userStories.title: Deep-dive style compare affordance
userStories.description: As a buyer, I want a familiar compare path from Agent Market into equipment deep dive or savings projection.
acceptanceCriteria: Each card can open equipment-deep-dive or savings-projection via ContentModule (moduleOpen) or in-page CTA
Copy uses equipment not kit
Lane HVAC can deep-link marketplace-hvac module as story context

userStories.title: Shortlist from Agent Market
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to save products and return to an agent without losing my shortlist.
acceptanceCriteria: Save writes greenways-product-shortlist in sessionStorage (same key Customer Hub expects)
Footer shows shortlist count; empty state explains Save
Ask Artemis / Ask Vincent CTA opens /greenways/{agent}?q= with product name or id hint
Works without login

userStories.title: Buy on Greenways Market handoff
userStories.description: As a buyer ready to purchase, I want a clear path to the real marketplace product page (and later Wix cart), not a fake checkout in the agent.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary buy CTA labels Buy on Greenways Market (or Open product page)
Opens marketplace product URL in new tab or fullPageHref from module chrome
No payment forms inside Agent Market v1
Optional later: Wix cart deep-link documented as AM-015 backlog when APIs ready

userStories.title: Sustainable alternatives compare row
userStories.description: As a buyer, I want to see marketplace products beside external sustainable alternatives in Agent Market, matching the deep-dive dual-lane pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: data/agent-market-showcase.json compareQuery per lane drives GET /api/agent-market/alternatives?lane=…
Agent Market UI: On Greenways Marketplace vs Not Yet on Greenways carousel columns
Marketplace column: View Marketplace Option, Save to shortlist, Savings projection
External column: Suggest for Greenways → POST marketplace-intake-suggestions with source agent-market
Open full product finder module link for ad-hoc search

userStories.title: External catalog images
userStories.description: As a buyer, I want Not Yet on Greenways cards to show real product photos, not empty placeholders.
acceptanceCriteria: sust_* rows in sustainable-products-catalog.json gain Wix static imageUrl where missing
Agent Market external carousel uses those images with a single shared fallback

userStories.title: Tune lane compare queries
userStories.description: As a buyer switching HVAC / water / premises lanes, I want both compare columns to show useful matches.
acceptanceCriteria: Review each lane compareQuery on Render
Adjust showcase compareQuery until marketplace + external columns are non-empty for typical queries

userStories.title: Agent chat tablets → Agent Market compare
userStories.description: As a visitor talking to Artemis or Zyanne, I want a tablet that opens Agent Market on the right lane or product compare.
acceptanceCriteria: Module tablet or link opens agent-market with ?lane= or productId compare context
Artemis and Zyanne knowledge/sidebar can surface the tablet

userStories.title: Research shortlist for external picks
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to bookmark Not Yet on Greenways options without implying I can buy them yet.
acceptanceCriteria: Separate sessionStorage list from buy shortlist (or clearly typed items)
UI does not show Buy CTA on research-only rows

userStories.title: Staff intake visibility
userStories.description: As staff, after Suggest for Greenways I want a clear path to review intake.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent Market shows brief confirmation + link/note to deep-dive intake shortlist or queue file
source agent-market remains distinguishable in marketplace-intake-suggestions.json

userStories.title: Strong candidate badge + efficiency pulse
userStories.description: As a buyer, I want high-saving external options flagged and energy sketch bars like deep dive.
acceptanceCriteria: Surface intakeCandidates / high savings as Strong candidate for listing (staff or public copy TBD)
Optional: reuse deep-dive efficiency pulse SVG on compare cards

userStories.title: Shared alternatives compare component
userStories.description: As maintainers, we want deep dive, finder, and Agent Market to share one compare card/repeater module.
acceptanceCriteria: Extract greenways-alternatives-compare.js (+ CSS) from deep-dive patterns
Agent Market and at least one other surface consume it

userStories.title: Wix cart deep-link (optional)
userStories.description: As a buyer ready to purchase, I want Buy to land in Wix cart when APIs are ready.
acceptanceCriteria: Document or implement Wix cart URL when available
No parallel payment UI inside Agent Market
